Sara T.: Heads-up — customer wants Sylph-22B onboarded for Private (VPC) with a 4-bit quantized runtime. They call this a P0 request, deadline EOW. Need triage and sanity/perf plan.
Devon: Thanks Sara. Can you drop the model artifact link and tokenizer? Also need clarity on target p95 for 256 tokens.
Sara T.: Artifact uploaded to internal bucket s3://redwood-infer/sylph-22b/v1 and tokenizer files at the same path. Target p95 < 120ms for 256 tokens on our a100-dedicated profile. Customer will accept higher latency if flagged, but wants bandwidth for concurrent requests.
Kevin L.: Noted. Quick checklist suggestion: 1) file checksum + tie to provenance, 2) small float32 smoke run, 3) quantization smoke (4-bit), 4) eval on priority promptset, 5) perf runs with batching and KV cache behavior, 6) compatibility with streaming + function-calls.
Maria Q.: I can run quant smoke today. Plan: base FP32 generation to get baseline perplexity and sample outputs -> run 4-bit q4_k_m or q4_0 variants and compare. If delta>3% on our eval metric we flag for manual review.
Kevin L.: Sounds good. Can you prioritize a q4_k_m path first? That usually preserves quality for Sylph-like architectures. Also confirm int8/4-bit kernels exist for the sequence lengths we expect.
Maria Q.: Copy. Starting with q4_k_m. Running the following command now:
```
./run_quant_smoke.sh --model s3://redwood-infer/sylph-22b/v1 --quant q4_k_m --batch 1 --seq 256 --out /tmp/sylph_q4_smoke.log
```
Sara T.: Quick customer context: typical payloads are short chat turns (20-80 tokens) but they stress test with 256 tokens for analytics. They expect streaming and function-calling to work. Also want model pinned on Dedicated if perf ok.
infra-bot: CI job queued: sylph-22b-fp32-smoke #4321. Artifact checksum verified (sha256: abcdef123456...).
eval-bot: Eval job created: sylph-22b-priority-promptset v1. Estimated runtime 45m.
Devon: Infra note — need to reserve a single dedicated slot (a100) for full perf sweep. If q4 path looks good we can try scaling tests (concurrency 8, batch sizes 1..8).
Kevin L.: Add a small hallucination/regression check: run these two prompts from customer safety suite and compare outputs. If top-1 exact match rate < 90% vs FP32 baseline, escalate.
Maria Q.: Running eval now. Initial FP32 sample generation done, outputs saved. q4_k_m run producing tokens — small log tail:
```
[INFO] seq=256 batch=1 runtime=0.082s per_token=0.00032s
[WARN] some fused-kernel fallback for block size mismatch, still ok
[INFO] sample perplexity delta vs fp32: 0.9%
```
Maria Q.: Early signs look promising, perplexity delta under 1%, latency measured ~95ms p95 on our a100 profile for 256 tokens. I'll push full eval + safety checks in ~30m.
Sara T.: Awesome. If all green we should schedule a canary on Dedicated and enable streaming test matrix. Devon, can you allocate the canary slot and schedule a handoff to ProdOps?
Devon: On it. Reserving slot and will create a runbook for canary rollout + rollback steps. I'll include autoscaling knobs to limit burst to 2x during canary.
Kevin L.: Once Maria posts final numbers, let's capture the prompts/outputs for the quality dashboard and tag the model with quant profile and recommended kernels. Also recommend quantization fallback policy: if p95 > 200ms or quality delta > 3%, fallback to fp16.
Maria Q.: Final: eval complete. Metrics: sample perplexity delta 0.8%, safety checks passed (no immediate regression flagged), p95=98ms (256 tokens), throughput 12 tokens/s for batch=1, concurrency=8 achieved ~9k tok/s aggregate. Uploading results to /artifacts/sylph-22b/v1/q4_k_m/report.json
Sara T.: Great work. Marking triage as DONE -> move to bring-up checklist: canary timeline tomorrow 10am PT, ProdOps + SRE notified. Will follow up with customer. :tada:
Devon: Created canary runbook and incident channel for the rollout. Tagging @SRE on the channel.
Kevin L.: Closing loop: add model to catalog with notes: sylph-22b:v1 -> quant profile q4_k_m recommended, fallback fp16, targeted p95 120ms.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-23T17:00:00Z on dedicated pool redwood-ded-a100-2.
Sara T.: Thanks team. If anything unexpected during canary ping here and escalate.
